name: Angelina Carranza
description: Sr. Product Manager @ Lively — payments nerd passionate about connecting people and products.
summary: Senior Product Manager at Lively in benefits administration and debit card processing, owning the roadmap for card services, claims, and enrollment integrations across two engineering teams. I build AI into both products and practice — I launched an AI claims adjudication platform that cut processing time from days to minutes — and led a 470,000-card processor migration in a 5-day cutover. My passion for connecting things — whether that be people or products — drives me to learn more about the world and find ways to integrate it better.

work.title: Senior Product Manager
work.description: Own the product roadmap for card services, claims processing, and enrollment integrations, leading 6 engineers across 2 teams. Launched Smart Claims, an AI-powered claims adjudication platform that automated 120,000+ claims, reduced processing time from 2–3 days to minutes, and cut manual operations workload by 66%+. Built an AI-powered explanation of benefits (EOB) analyzer prototype with one engineer in 2 months to detect insurance billing inconsistencies. Partner with engineering, operations, compliance, vendors, and C-suite stakeholders, and mentor PMs on product practices.

work.title: Product Manager
work.description: Product manager for all things related to spend. Led Lively's largest debit card platform modernization, migrating 470,000 debit cards from Visa DPS to Fiserv in a 5-day cutover without reissuing cards — delivered on schedule to avoid $300K in additional costs and reduce annual vendor costs by hundreds of thousands of dollars. Delivered card lifecycle enhancements, including automated card reissuance and push provisioning, to support rapid cardholder growth.

work.title: Product Manager - Debit Card Solutions
work.description: Led product initiatives for debit card solutions within Lively's HSA/FSA spend platform.

work.title: Analyst - Business Strategy & Operations
work.description: Member of the newly created DPS Center for Excellence team. Developed a framework to streamline product development and delivery for 8 product lines by researching industry best practices, interviewing stakeholders, and implementing a change management plan.

work.title: Sr. Associate, Business Strategy and Operations
work.description: Volunteered to migrate 14 marketing campaigns to Adobe Experience Manager to meet a year-end deadline, and was invited back for a high-visibility client engagement that generated $3 million in revenue. Selected from 800+ internal applicants for a 3-month project defining a collaboration process across product, consulting, and marketing teams to upsell value-added services.

work.title: Product Associate
work.description: Member of the Core Debit product team. Owned enhancements for Interactive Voice Response (IVR) and Contact Center products by gathering customer feedback, writing product requirements, and prioritizing the backlog. Partnered with developers to deliver 15 product enhancements, including 2 new services launched in 2019, and automated a manual billing process with a Python script.

work.title: PR Assistant
work.description: Updated databases of press contacts using FileMaker. Tracked events and publicity for bands Elephant Revival and Making Movies. Assisted with drafting emails and press releases in Spanish for media outlets.

work.title: Marketing Intern
work.description: Researched marketing opportunities for various products. Developed long-term marketing strategies for business growth. Generated social media marketing ideas and created posts for Facebook and Twitter.

work.title: Game Advisor
work.description: Greeted customers and used solution selling to identify their needs and recommend products. Worked with team members to generate sales while emphasizing customer service.
